props.label: About Us
props.heading: A flower shop that keeps wedding-morning hours
props.body:
Gulmohar started in 2009 as a single garland counter on Sitabuldi Main Road, tying marigold for the temples across the street.

The car decoration came later, almost by accident — a customer asked us to dress his brother's Ambassador for a baraat, and we have been doing it ever since. Today car work is more than half of what we do, and we still tie the temple garlands every morning.

We buy at the Kalamna flower market between 4 and 5 a.m., which is why our roses open on your wedding day and not the night before. Everything is fitted on site by our own team, and we finish a full hour before your muhurat — never at the last minute, never while the baraat waits.

pillars.title: Finished an hour early
pillars.text: We fit and finish a full hour before your muhurat, so nothing is being tied while the baraat is waiting.

pillars.title: Cut the same morning
pillars.text: Bought at Kalamna market between 4 and 5 a.m. — the flowers open on your day, not the night before.

pillars.title: Fitted without damage
pillars.text: Magnetic and suction mounts only. No tape on your paint, no adhesive, no scratches — we remove everything after.

pillars.title: Fixed written quote

items.title: Classic Rose Car Decoration
items.desc: A heart or oval rose arrangement across the bonnet, with matching mirror and handle work. Our most-booked car package.
items.body:
The package most of our baraat customers book, and the one we have fitted more than any other.

A rose arrangement is built across the bonnet in a heart or oval, with smaller matching pieces on the wing mirrors and door handles. If you choose the wider coverage we carry the flowers down the doors and add a ribbon trail along the boot.

Everything mounts with magnets and suction cups. There is no tape, no glue and nothing adhesive touching your paint, and we come back to remove it all after the function at no extra cost.

We reach your address 90 minutes before you need the car and finish a clear hour before you leave. Tell us the car's colour when you book and we will match the ribbon to it.

items.title: Royal Full-Car Decoration
items.desc: Full-length floral runner from bonnet to boot, pillar work and a decorated roofline — the package for the bride and groom's car.
items.body:
This is the car everyone photographs, so it is built to hold up in photographs.

A continuous floral runner is laid from the bonnet across the roof to the boot, with worked pillars, mirror pieces and a finished roofline. The white-and-green theme is the classic choice; red rose reads stronger in evening light, and pastel pink photographs best in daylight.

Because the runner crosses the roof we need the car for a full 90 minutes, and we ask that it be washed and dry before we start — flowers do not sit well on a wet or dusty finish.

Mounting is magnetic and suction only, and removal after the function is included. For an open-top or vintage car, message us first so we can plan the mounting.

items.title: Car Interior Floral Setup
items.desc: Dashboard and rear-deck arrangements with a fresh-flower scent — for the ride home, the airport pickup or an anniversary surprise.
items.body:
Not every occasion needs the outside of the car dressed. This one works inside it.

A low arrangement is fitted along the dashboard, the rear deck, or both, shaped so it never blocks your mirror or your view. We use non-slip bases so nothing moves when you brake.

It is the setup people book for an anniversary drive, a first ride home after the wedding, or an airport pickup — and it is the one arrangement we can usually do same-day.

Roses carry the strongest scent in a closed car. Lilies look the most dramatic but are heavily perfumed, so tell us if anyone travelling is sensitive to it.

items.title: Vintage Car Decoration
items.desc: Retro-styled florals for a Beetle, Ambassador or open-top — ribbons, hearts and trailing garlands built for the photographs.
items.body:
Vintage cars are decorated differently, and we plan them differently too.

Older paint and chrome mark easily, so we work with soft ties and padded mounts instead of the magnets we use on modern cars. The styling leans retro — heart pieces on the bonnet, ribbon and tulle trails, and garlands along the running boards.

Open-top cars get a rear-seat surround, which is the shot most couples actually want.

Send a photograph of the car when you enquire. Every vintage body is a different shape and we would rather plan the mounting before the day than improvise on it.

productInfo.label: Before you book
productInfo.value: Send a photo of the car

items.title: Bridal Bouquet
items.desc: A hand-tied bouquet with a wrapped, ribboned handle — made the morning of, not the night before.
items.body:
Hand-tied the morning of your function, so it is at its best when you are holding it and not eight hours earlier.

The handle is wrapped and ribboned to match your outfit — tell us the colour and we will match it. The medium size photographs best for most brides; the large is for a full-length lehenga shot where a smaller bouquet disappears.

We can deliver it to your home, the parlour or the venue, whichever is easier on the morning.

If you want the bouquet to match the car decoration, book both together and we will use the same flowers across the two.

items.title: Fresh Flower Garlands
items.desc: Marigold, jasmine and rose garlands by the piece or in bulk — for temples, poojas, shop openings and welcome lines.
items.body:
The work we started with, and still the first thing tied every morning.

Garlands are made to the length you order — 3 feet for a welcome garland or a photo frame, 5 feet for doorways and pillars, 8 feet for stage edges and gate work.

Marigold lasts longest and holds colour in the sun, which is why it is the standard for outdoor and daytime work. Jasmine is the most fragrant but wilts fastest, so we cut it as late as we can. The marigold-and-jasmine mix is the usual choice for weddings.

For temples, offices and shops we run a standing daily delivery before 7 a.m. at a lower per-piece rate. Bulk orders above 50 garlands need 24 hours' notice.

items.title: Stage Backdrop Package
items.desc: A full floral backdrop with pillars and seating florals, built to your stage width — for weddings, receptions and sangeet.
items.body:
Priced by stage width, because that is what actually determines the work.

A 10-foot backdrop suits a home function or a small hall. 16 feet is the usual banquet stage. 24 feet is for a large lawn or a hotel ballroom, where anything narrower looks lost.

Fresh flowers are unmatched for a daytime function and photograph beautifully, but they are cut that morning and are at their best for about eight hours. Premium artificial holds up for a multi-day function, an outdoor mandap in peak summer, or a late-night reception — and it costs less.

Every booking includes a site visit before the day. Setup and teardown are included; we arrive the morning of unless your venue only allows access the night before.

items.title: Table Centerpieces
items.desc: Low or tall arrangements for guest tables — priced per table, delivered arranged and ready to place.
items.body:
Priced per table and delivered already arranged, so your venue staff only have to place them.

Low arrangements sit under eye level and let guests talk across the table — the right choice for a dinner. Tall arrangements on a raised stand make far more impact in photographs and suit a reception, where people are moving around rather than seated.

Minimum order is 5 tables. Vases are included on loan and collected the next day; if one goes missing we simply do not charge for it.

Order these with a stage backdrop and we will use the same flowers so the room reads as one setup.

posts.title: Will flower decoration damage your car's paint?
posts.excerpt: Not if it is fitted properly. What magnetic and suction mounting actually means, why tape and glue should never touch your paint, and what to check before the decorator starts.

posts.title: Marigold, rose or jasmine: which lasts longest?
posts.excerpt: Marigold holds colour all day in the sun, jasmine is the most fragrant but wilts fastest, and rose sits in between. How to choose for a daytime or evening function.

posts.title: How far ahead should you book a decorator?
posts.excerpt: Forty-eight hours is enough for a car. A stage needs a week and a site visit. In wedding season, the good dates go a month out — here is how the calendar really fills.

items.q: Will the decoration damage my car's paint?
items.a: No. We mount everything with magnets and suction cups — no tape, no glue and nothing adhesive touches your paint. We also come back after the function to remove it all at no extra cost. For vintage cars, where the paint and chrome are more delicate, we use padded soft ties instead.

items.q: How far in advance should I book?
items.a: Forty-eight hours is enough for a car decoration. Stage and mandap work needs about a week because it includes a site visit. During wedding season and around major festivals the good dates go a month ahead, so book as early as you can once your date is fixed.

items.q: How long do fresh flowers last on the day?
items.a: Fresh flowers are cut the same morning and look their best for roughly eight hours, which covers a normal function comfortably. For a multi-day event, an outdoor mandap in peak summer, or a late-night reception, we recommend premium artificial — it holds up right through and costs less.

Yes. Travel is free anywhere inside Nagpur city. Beyond city limits we add a travel charge based on distance, quoted in writing before you confirm. We regularly cover Wardha, Bhandara, Katol and Ramtek.

items.q: What if it rains on the day?
items.a: Car decorations are fitted under cover wherever possible and we carry replacement flowers to touch up afterwards at no charge. For outdoor stage work we will advise you honestly at the site visit about what will and will not survive weather, and suggest a covered alternative if the forecast is bad.

items.q: Can I cancel or change my booking?
items.a: Cancel more than 48 hours before and the advance is fully refunded. Inside 48 hours the flowers have already been bought at market, so the advance is not refundable — but we will happily move your booking to another date at no cost. Changes to flowers or coverage are free until 24 hours before.

items.q: How do I pay, and is a deposit required?
items.a: We take 30% as an advance to confirm the date and the balance on the day, by UPI, card or cash. The written quote is the final amount — we do not add festival or peak-season surcharges after you have confirmed.

props.heading: Tell us your date
props.sub: Send us the date, the car or the venue, and roughly what you have in mind. We will send a written quote the same day — no visit needed to get a price.

props.heading: Book a decoration
props.sub: The shop is open from 6 a.m. — we are usually back from the flower market by seven. Send your date and we will confirm availability the same day.

notes:
CONTENT MODEL: Built as a flower decoration business (Gulmohar Flower Decor) on Sitabuldi Main Road, Nagpur, with WEDDING CAR DECORATION as the lead offering — it is the hero promise, the first three products, and the first service card. Four real pages via the recipe-level 'pages' array (consumed by api/sites/create.php): Home (/), Decorations (/decorations), Shop (/shop) and Contact (/contact). The header nav and footer links point at those slugs, so the site is genuinely multi-page out of the box; the renderer auto-fills header/footer on pages that don't carry them. Per-page 'content' overrides retitle the shared services/products/gallery sections so the same section reads differently on each page.

VIDEO: The home hero plays a muted, looping, autoplay background video of hanging rose garlands (videoUrl — a direct MP4 from Pexels) under a 0.58 overlay, rendering light-on-dark. The 'image' field is the static fallback and is deliberately a car-decoration shot, so the car focus reads even if the video is blocked or slow. Both should be swapped for the business's own footage before going live.

IMAGES: All photos are hosted Pexels CDN URLs (https://images.pexels.com/photos/<id>/pexels-photo-<id>.jpeg?auto=compress&cs=tinysrgb&w=...). SiteRenderer::media passes any http(s) URL through untouched. EVERY URL in this file was fetched and visually checked before being used — two candidates were dropped because the deterministic filename pattern 404s for some Pexels photos, so do NOT add an id here without downloading it first. A few ids repeat across gallery/blog deliberately; all should be replaced with the business's own photography before going live.

PRODUCTS: Eight packages exercise the full products manifest — nested attributes, per-combination variants with SKU/price/MRP/stock, body copy, productInfo tables and slugs for individual product pages. The attribute axes are the ones this trade actually sells on: Flower × Coverage for cars, Stage Width × Fresh-vs-Artificial for backdrops, Flower × Length for garlands. Variant option strings must match the attribute option values EXACTLY or the renderer shows 'combination not available'. The last variant of each product is deliberately stock 0 to exercise the out-of-stock and disabled add-to-cart states.

PRICING: Set at realistic Indian flower-decoration market levels for a tier-2 city as of mid-2026 — car decoration ₹2,499–₹14,999, garlands ₹149–₹649, stage backdrops ₹11,999–₹42,999. Fresh is priced ABOVE premium artificial throughout, which matches the trade. Verify against the business's own rate card before going live.

TRUST SIGNALS: The decisive objections in this trade are paint damage, wilting and last-minute no-shows, so 'no tape on your paint', 'cut the same morning', 'finished an hour before the muhurat' and 'the quote is the bill' run through the hero, about pillars, FAQ, reviews and terms. Keep these even when the copy is rewritten.

NO TEAM SECTION: Deliberately omitted, following the salon/gym/wedding convention of not pairing stock photographs with invented staff names — and to keep the site to the four pages requested.

BUSINESS INFO: Address is Sitabuldi Main Road, Nagpur, with the Kalamna flower market referenced in the about copy as the sourcing story. Phone, WhatsApp and email are placeholders to be replaced. Social is Instagram, Facebook and YouTube — Instagram is by far the most important channel for this trade.
